items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I wish I could have heard more of Bessie, I'm sorry I didn't hear Ma Rainey. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I forgot what, I forgot what, just but a vaudeville I saw like it, you know. Some kind of vaudeville.

ctx.x: I did it in the chorus. See, Clarence William, Clarence William got sick, see, he couldn't work no more with her. And by me, I wasn't doing chorus, I could play piano right on, playing piano, that's why I got my style in the chorus, see. Like that.

Yeah, I wish I could have heard more of Bessie, I'm sorry I didn't hear Ma Rainey. Yeah. What kind of show did Ma Rainey travel with, do you remember when you'd hear what kind of a show it was, or what she did?
I forgot what, I forgot what, just but a vaudeville I saw like it, you know. Some kind of vaudeville. A vaudeville, yeah.
